action.reset-client-password: Reset the password of a machine

status.title: Status
status.disk_almost_full_title: The repository disk is almost full
status.disk_almost_full_description: {percent}% of the disk is used. When the disk is full, the machines cannot back up any more. Free some space, add disk space or lower the retention in the settings.
status.days_left: Expires today | Expires in {count} day | Expires in {count} days
status.certificate_note: Machines pin it. When it expires, enroll them again.
status.certificate_near_description: Every enrolled machine pins this certificate. After it expires, all machines lose their connection until you run the enrollment script on each of them again.
status.verify_failed_description: Some repository data could not be read back. See the details in the integrity check card and check the logs.
status.name: Name
status.verify_unfinished_title: The last integrity check did not finish
status.verify_unfinished_description: It ran out of time before reading its share of the data. No error was found in the part it read. Lower the share of data to check on the Policies page.

clients.title: Clients
clients.not_configured_description: The server is not running yet. Configure the module first.
clients.no_machines_description: Add a machine to get its enrollment script.
clients.add_description: A machine is identified by user name and host name. Both appear in the Kopia web UI.
clients.username_helper: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
clients.hostname_helper: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
clients.owner_email_helper: The owner gets a mail when the machine stops backing up.
clients.name_format: Use lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore. Start and end with a letter or a digit.
clients.enrollment_intro: Run this script on the machine to connect it to the server. To reinstall a machine, reset its password and run the new script. It gets its old snapshots back.
clients.enrollment_user_title: Run it in the user session
clients.enrollment_user_description: Run the script as the user who owns the files. Do not run it as administrator or as SYSTEM.
clients.enrollment_secret_description: Never put the script in a GPO or in Intune in clear text. Anyone who reads it can read, restore and delete the backups of this machine, from anywhere. If it leaks, reset the password.
clients.reset_warning: The machine loses its connection to the server until you run the new enrollment script on it. Its snapshots are kept.
clients.remove_warning: The account of this machine is removed. The machine cannot back up any more.
clients.remove_snapshots: Its snapshots stay in the repository. An administrator can browse them in the Kopia web UI.
clients.enrollment_once_description: It holds the password of the machine. It will not be shown again. To get a new script, reset the password.
clients.enrollment_hidden_title: The password is shown only once
clients.enrollment_hidden_description: The enrollment script was shown when the machine was added or its password reset. To install or reinstall the machine, reset its password: you get a new script.

settings.title: Settings
settings.host_choose_description: Choose the host name before you enroll the first machine. Every machine keeps it in its connection URL.
settings.host_locked_helper: Locked while machines are enrolled. Remove all machines to change it.
settings.lets_encrypt_admin_only: The certificate only covers the admin web UI. The client port keeps the module certificate.
settings.client_port_helper: Must be reachable from the Internet for roaming machines. Use a port outside 20000-45000.
settings.admin_user_helper: The user name of the web UI is always admin.
settings.repository_password_warning: This password is the only way to read the backups. It cannot be recovered. If you lose it, all backups are lost.
settings.repository_password_written_down: I wrote this password down outside this server
settings.show_repository_password_warning: Anyone who sees this password can read all the backups. Copy it to a safe place and close this window.
settings.keep_range: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000 (100 for annual)
settings.excludes_too_long: A pattern can have 255 characters at most
settings.hours_range: Enter a whole number from 1 to 8760
settings.admin_after_owner: The admin delay must be greater than the owner delay
settings.route_missing_description: Another instance on this node owns this host and this client port, as after a clone on the same node. Remove the old instance, then save these settings to start this one. The machines keep working without any change.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This host name is already used by another application
settings.port_in_allocator_range: This port is in the range 20000-45000 used by the node. Choose another port.
settings.port_used_by_module: This port is already used by another module
settings.port_in_use: This port is already in use on the node
settings.host_locked_by_agents: The host cannot change while machines are enrolled
settings.port_locked_by_agents: The port cannot change while machines are enrolled
settings.cannot_check_agents: Cannot check the enrolled machines. Try again later.
settings.password_length: The password must have 12 to 64 characters
settings.password_characters: Use only letters, digits and these symbols: . , _ + : @ % ^ = ~ -
settings.password_classes: Use an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a symbol
settings.repository_password_already_set: The repository password is already set. It never changes.
settings.mail_failed: The test mail could not be sent. Check the smarthost settings.
settings.verify_percent_range: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100

policies.title: Policies
policies.not_configured_title: The module is not configured yet
policies.not_configured_description: Set the host name and the passwords in the settings first.
policies.backup_policy_description: These rules apply to every machine.
policies.excludes_helper: One pattern per line, gitignore syntax. Every machine ignores them.
policies.verify_helper_none: Only the index and the presence of every pack are checked. No data is downloaded. Silent corruption is not detected.
policies.verify_helper_partial: About {percent}% of the data is read again every Sunday at 03:00. At 10%, the whole repository is covered within a few months.
policies.verify_helper_all: All data is read every Sunday. This takes long on a big repository.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.not_configured_title: The module is not configured yet
alerts.not_configured_description: Set the host name and the passwords in the settings first.
alerts.smarthost_missing_description: Alert mails need the cluster smarthost. Configure it to send alerts.
alerts.owner_alert_hours_helper: Hours without a backup before the owner of the machine gets a mail.
alerts.admin_alert_hours_helper: Hours without a backup before the admins get a mail. It must be greater than the owner delay.
alerts.alert_sender_helper: Leave empty to use the default sender.
alerts.test_mail_sent_description: A test mail was sent to {recipient}.
